thread:
Alex: Heads-up — 1.12.2 hotfix cutoff in ~45m. We want minimal diffs only (kvcache timeout and a tiny docs bump). Who can own final cherrypick + push? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria: I can grab the kvcache cherrypick (PR #4821). I pushed the branch `hotfix/kvcache-435` to my fork. Will open a release PR to `release/1.12` in a bit. tagging tests.
Tim: Thanks @Maria. I'll start a quick smoke run against that branch now. If anything fails I'll post logs here.
Sam: FYI QA: I can do the quick regression after Tim's smoke. ETA 20m. Keep diffs tiny — no feature merges.
Maria: Pushed the cherrypick commit (sha abc1234). Release PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4821 — title "cherry-pick: fix kvcache timeout (#435)". Added short changelog entry in the PR description.
Tim: Running smoke: real-time tail below — will attach snippet if it flakes
Tim: ```
RUN: tests/smoke.sh --target hotfix/kvcache-435
...
OK  core/startup  (1m 2s)
FAIL network/conn-retry (0m 12s)  <-- flaky heisenbug
```
Alex: That network flake is unrelated to this change, we saw it yesterday. @Tim can you re-run just the subset we care about (`kvcache` + critical startup)?
Tim: Re-ran targeted subset, all green: `kvcache.*` and `core/startup` ✅
Sam: QA run started against the release PR now. Will focus on the two failing patterns from earlier to confirm isolation.
Jen: Small reminder — version bump and tag needed in the release branch. Use semver patch: `1.12.2` and append `-hotfix` suffix for the RC? I'd prefer straight `1.12.2` tag once merged. Also ensure changelog header has the hotfix note.
Maria: Agreed. In the release PR I added a changelog snippet under "Patch" and a small package.json version bump in the PR branch. If maintainers want tag creation disabled until CI passes, that's fine.
release-bot: [auto] release-checklist: code_review=approved? false, ci_status=pending, required_signoffs=1. Please add a maintainer review.
Alex: @Jen can you do the maintainer review once QA green? Trying to keep this fast.
Jen: Will review after Sam confirms QA. If looks good, I'll approve and merge, then we can cut the tag.
Sam: QA finished. Regression checks for kvcache + startup passed. Found only a doc lint nit, not blocking.
Jen: Approved and merging now. Command I used:```bash
git checkout release/1.12
git pull origin release/1.12\git merge --no-ff hotfix/kvcache-435 -m "merge: hotfix kvcache (#4821)"
git push origin release/1.12
```
Maria: Once merged, please create the annotated tag: `git tag -a v1.12.2 -m "v1.12.2 hotfix: kvcache timeout fix"` then `git push origin v1.12.2`
Alex: After tag, I'll coordinate the cutover and small canary rollout. We'll keep 10% traffic to the hotfix for 30m. If no regressions, full rollout.
release-bot: [auto] deployplan created: canary=10%, duration=30m, fallback=rollback-to-v1.12.1. Track: https://deploy/reports/plan/9832
Tim: Canary smoke looks fine after 10m. No new errors in traces.
Alex: Rolling to 100% now. :shipit:
Maria: Nice work team — minimal diff, no surprises. I'll follow up with a short changelog email for customers.
Jen: Quick note for postmortem: keep an eye on txn latency for first 2 hours after full rollout.
Alex: Agreed. I'll leave monitoring on high for 2 hours. Closing thread once graphs stable. :eyes:
